subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@drifthealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Redwood_Requirements_Checklist.pdf (pdf stub)

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the discovery conversation earlier today. Per our discussion, I’ve put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a couple of timeline options so we can align on milestones, owners, and dependencies. Please find the draft attached and see the summary below.

High-level target: Q4 2026 pilot -> Production target close: 2026-11-30 (option to accelerate to 2026-11-15 if approvals and infra gating items finish early).

Proposed milestones (draft):
- M1: Pilot scoping & requirements sign-off — Owner: DriftHealth Product (suggested: Samir) — Target: 2026-08-31 — Dependencies: API access, sample data subset
- M2: Dedicated capacity sizing & infra prep — Owner: Redwood Onboarding (Rishi) — Target: 2026-09-10 — Dependencies: expected token/throughput profile
- M3: Pilot implementation & test run — Owner: DriftHealth Eng (Leah) / Redwood SE (Rishi) — Target: 2026-10-10 — Dependencies: access to staging, API keys, data retention settings
- M4: Pilot evaluation & quality signoff — Owner: DriftHealth Ops/Product — Target: 2026-10-25
- M5: Production rollout & SLA handover — Owner: Redwood Customer Success (Ava) / DriftHealth Eng — Target close: 2026-11-30

Key asks from you in this week:
1) Confirm primary stakeholder(s) who will own each milestone on the DriftHealth side (I noted Product/Eng above as suggestions).
2) Indicate which timeline option you prefer (Standard: targets above; Accelerated: shift all targets ~2 weeks earlier).
3) Share any procurement or security gating items we should add to the MAP (e.g., SOC 2 evidence request, VPC networking window).

Next steps if we get alignment this week:
- We’ll lock the MAP and create a shared Drive folder (link attached) and open a HubSpot plan entry (deal RDW-2389).
- Rishi will schedule a short infra kickcall to confirm sizing and network requirements.

If you’re good with this, can you confirm the stakeholder list and preferred timeline by EOD Tue (2026-08-17)? Happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up if helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (attached) — contains a row-per-milestone view with owner, target date, acceptance criteria and blocking items.

Cc: Leah Morgan <leah.morgan@drifthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary and appreciate the draft. A few quick notes:

- We like the standard timeline but would like to try the accelerated timeline if we can get procurement sign-off this week.
- Primary stakeholders: Samir (Product) will own M1 and M4; Leah (Eng) will own M3 and co-own M5; I'll loop in Procurement (Carol Nguyen) and Security (Diego Ramos) into the MAP — they’ll be the approvers for SOC 2 and contract terms.
- Procurement request: we need estimated monthly cost range for pilot and expected /peak token throughput so Procurement can approve the budget.

I’ll confirm Procurement and Security contacts by EOD today and can join the infra kickcall — Leah will coordinate on the staging access.

On the attachments: I opened the MAP draft and left one inline comment on the acceptance criteria for M3 (latency SLA for 95th pct).

Samir
Head of Product, DriftHealth
samir@drifthealth.com
